characters.summary: Brainiac is a hyper-intelligent coluan android/cyborg entity who travels the cosmos shrinking and bottling cities to preserve their knowledge before destroying their parent planets. He utilizes vast mental capabilities, telepathy, telekinesis, and advanced drone technology.
limitations: Requires specialized containment machinery to shrink cities
Bound by his core directive to collect and preserve intelligence rather than pure destruction

sources.supports: General origin, technological nature, and universe-conquering motivations.

feats.claim: Bottled the city of Kandor from Krypton before its destruction.

notableResults.note: Superman defeated Brainiac's avatar and breached his ship.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced Coluan technology and drone armies.
Possesses vast psionic and telepathic power.

unknowns: Exact limits of his telepathic range without his ship's amplification.

characters.summary: Nathaniel Adam is a military officer fused with alien Quantum Field metal, granting him absolute manipulation over quantum energy. He fights using energy projection, flight, matter transmutation, and immense durability.

mechanisms: Invulnerability granted by metallic containment skin

weaknesses: Breach of his metallic skin releases uncontrollable quantum energy
limitations: Risk of quantum cascade if his suit is excessively damaged
Requires conscious focus to maintain matter structure

sources.supports: Origin, quantum field powers, and general abilities.

feats.claim: Absorbed and redirected massive nuclear explosions.

notableResults.note: Fought evenly before the conflict was resolved through negotiation.

campaignTags.claim: Flies naturally through manipulation of gravitational and quantum fields.
Manipulates and discharges massive amounts of energy.

unknowns: The exact ceiling of his capacity to absorb foreign energy types.

characters.summary: Leonard Snart is the methodical leader of the Rogues, utilizing a specialized absolute-zero cold gun to freeze targets instantly. He relies on tactical planning, absolute zero fields, and criminal cunning rather than physical super-powers.

mechanisms: Slow-down field around his immediate area

weaknesses: Normal human physical durability when caught off guard
Dependence on his cold gun tech
limitations: Weapon can be broken or disarmed
Relies on regular maintenance and power cartridges for his cold gun

sources.supports: Origin, use of cold gun, and leadership of the Rogues.

feats.claim: Created a localized absolute-zero field that slows down molecular motion, stopping kinetic projectiles and slowing down The Flash.

notableResults.note: Typically defeated by Flash's speed unless using elaborate traps or teamwork with the Rogues.

conditional.ability: Absolute zero projection and ice generation

campaignTags.claim: Wields a specialized cold gun capable of projecting absolute zero temperatures.
Uses custom-built cryogenic weaponry and gear.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how his cold field interacts with cosmic-level speeds outside standard Flash encounters.

characters.summary: Cassandra Cain is a master martial artist trained from birth as the ultimate human assassin. She reads body language to anticipate opponents' movements instantly, granting her near-precognitive combat awareness.
weaknesses: Initial difficulty with verbal communication and reading text
Standard human physical vulnerability to bullets and heavy energy attacks
limitations: Lacks long-range projectile weaponry outside of standard thrown gadgets

sources.supports: Upbringing as an assassin, body-reading ability, and Batgirl mantle.

feats.claim: Dodged point-blank gunfire by reading the twitch of the shooter's muscles before the trigger was pulled.

notableResults.note: Defeated her mother Lady Shiva in mortal combat after mastering her own mindset.

campaignTags.claim: Trained master of stealth and assassination infiltration.
Utilizes standard Batman family utility belt and batarangs.

unknowns: Effectiveness against opponents with completely erratic or non-biological movement patterns.

characters.summary: Selina Kyle is a master cat burglar and skilled street-level combatant. She specializes in stealth, whip-handling, infiltration, and acrobatic hand-to-hand fighting.
weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability to firearms and blunt trauma
limitations: Purely human physical stats with no super-strength or durability

sources.supports: Skills as a thief, combat training, and equipment.

feats.claim: Infiltrated heavily secured high-tech vaults undetected by bypassing laser grids and guard patrols.

notableResults.note: Frequently apprehended or stalemated by Batman in direct confrontations, though she often successfully escapes using prep and environment.

campaignTags.claim: Master cat burglar specializing in silent infiltration and theft.
Uses a bullwhip, claw attachments, and lockpicks.

unknowns: Performance against opponents possessing superhuman speed or armor.

characters.summary: Barbara Ann Minerva, empowered by the plant god Urzkartaga, possesses superhuman speed, razor-sharp claws, and predatory ferocity. She fights as a close-quarters blitz attacker capable of matching top-tier powerhouses.
weaknesses: Magical vulnerability or psychological instability depending on her host bond with Urzkartaga
limitations: Relies entirely on melee range closing speed

sources.supports: Origin through Urzkartaga, superhuman speed, and status as Wonder Woman's rival.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Wonder Woman in close-quarters combat, utilizing speed to bypass defenses.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Wonder Woman successfully anticipates her speed blitz.

campaignTags.claim: Not applicable

unknowns: Exact top speed when fully fueled by divine bloodlust.

characters.summary: Circe is an immortal and immensely powerful sorceress devoted to Hecate. She commands dark magic, reality-altering transmutation spells, mind control, and energy projection.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to divine interference or disruption of her focal magical artifacts/rituals
limitations: Spells require spoken incantations or focused gestures
Power is tied to her divine patron Hecate

sources.supports: Immortality, magical prowess, and status as a major DC sorceress.

feats.claim: Transformed an entire city of people into mutated animal beasts simultaneously.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Wonder Woman resisted her magic through sheer willpower and divine aid.

campaignTags.claim: Commands master-level sorcery granted by the goddess Hecate.
Casts complex transmutation and illusion spells.
Able to mentally dominate mortals and gods alike.

unknowns: Limits of her transmutation against beings with absolute magic immunity.

characters.summary: Basil Karlo (Clayface) is a shapeshifting metahuman composed of protoplasmic clay. He can alter his body shape, mimic any human appearance, form weapons out of his limbs, and trap opponents in his sticky mass.

mechanisms: Fluid body absorbs physical impacts harmlessly

weaknesses: Extreme temperatures (freezing or extreme heat can harden or melt him)
limitations: Vulnerable to chemical solvents and extreme thermal shifts
Cannot easily pass through fine mesh or airtight barriers when in liquid form

sources.supports: Clay composition, shapeshifting abilities, and Batman rogue status.

feats.claim: Absorbed and mimicked the powers of the entire Mud Pack and various heroes temporarily.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Batman using specialized freezing agents and chemical binders.

campaignTags.claim: Can drastically alter his mass and size to become a giant clay monster.
Can grow well past 8 feet tall into a massive monster form.

unknowns: Exact upper limit on the volume of clay he can absorb and control.

characters.summary: James Gordon is a seasoned police detective and commissioner of the GCPD. He relies on tactical firearms, police backup, investigative acumen, and gritty determination rather than superhuman abilities.
weaknesses: Standard human mortality and vulnerability to injury
limitations: Normal human strength, speed, and endurance

sources.supports: Role as police commissioner, tactical experience, and firearms training.

feats.claim: Successfully coordinated city-wide defense operations during major gang wars and supervillain breakouts.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and gravely wounded by the Joker, but survived and helped capture him later.

campaignTags.claim: Experienced in piloting police vehicles and transport.

unknowns: Performance in direct single combat against superpowered metahumans without tactical preparation.

characters.summary: Victor Stone is a cybernetic hero integrated with advanced alien Mother Box technology. He fights using sonic cannons, techno-pathic hacking, teleportation boom tubes, and high durability armor.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to advanced computer viruses or electromagnetic pulse (EMP) interference
Internal human organs still require baseline care
limitations: Dependent on energy power cells or Mother Box power output for high-end functions
Hacking can fail against sufficiently alien or magical firewalls

sources.supports: Origin, cybernetic enhancements, and Mother Box integration.

feats.claim: Hacked into Apokolips mainframe systems to disrupt Darkseid's forces.

notableResults.note: Defeated his rogue cybernetic duplicate by overriding its control protocols.

campaignTags.claim: Fused with advanced cybernetic implants and alien technology.
Features extensive artificial intelligence and computer processing systems.
Generates Boom Tubes for instant interplanetary and interdimensional teleportation.
Cybernetic parts can self-repair using internal nano-tech.

unknowns: Full capacity of Mother Box adaptation against abstract cosmic forces.
